# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a portrait-first browser drawing game called `Pastel Quest Doodle Shrine`. Preserve the source mechanics: a mobile-safe freehand canvas where dragging draws smoothed strokes, brush color and brush size can be selected, eraser mode removes marks, undo removes the last stroke, reset clears the page, and the progress counter increments per completed stroke. Do not add timers, combat, damage, puzzle failure, or punitive scoring.

The world is a satirical cozy Zelda-inspired pastel shrine where a tiny bestie hero uses a soft sword-brush to doodle calming runes. Use soft girl aesthetic, pastel dream colors, decora-kei ornaments, meme copy like `bestie` and `era`, and search-visible terms like `drawing game`, `drawing`, and `puzzle`. Build procedural browser-native visuals: animated fantasy forest, rune rings, shrine motifs, cute hero silhouette, sparkly particles, readable HUD chips, and a reachable bottom toolbar for one-thumb iOS/Android play.

# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: mobile-first freehand canvas drawing toy with light puzzle/quest framing and relaxing creative play.
- objective: draw one-thumb strokes/runes on a protected canvas, choose brush colors/sizes, optionally erase, undo, or reset; progress is represented by stroke/rune count rather than failure pressure.
- input model: pointer/touch drag on the canvas creates smoothed line segments; toolbar buttons select brush color, brush size, eraser, undo, reset, and sound.
- core loop: open page, read hint, drag to draw, receive stroke feedback and updated count, adjust tools, continue drawing or clear/undo.
- fail/friction state: no hard fail state; friction comes from accidental marks, resolved through eraser/undo/reset. This anti-anxiety no-loss model is protected.

## Protected mechanics
- Single-canvas freehand line drawing with smoothed pointer paths.
- One-thumb pointer/touch drawing on the drawing surface only.
- Brush color selection, three brush sizes, eraser mode, undo-last-stroke, reset-all-strokes.
- Stroke/rune count as the progress signal.
- No timer, no damage, no win/loss condition, and no punitive scoring.
- Mobile portrait layout with reachable bottom toolbar and readable top HUD.

## Remixed target
Pastel Quest Doodle Shrine is a satirical cozy Zelda-inspired drawing game: the player is a tiny bestie hero using a soft sword-brush to doodle calming shrine runes in a pastel dream forest. It preserves the freehand drawing toy mechanics while transforming the world, HUD vocabulary, focal mascot, background, particles, and feedback into a decora-kei anti-anxiety sketch quest.
